messages.content:
You are proposing scientific conjectures. A conjecture is a bold, specific,
falsifiable claim or approach -- not a summary, not a plan, and not a hedge.
Write plainly.

Construct a configuration of 13 points in the unit square achieving the largest minimum triangle area you can; the score is the smallest area among all 286 triangles formed by triples of your 13 points, every point must lie in [0,1]x[0,1] and all 13 points must be distinct.

Stay within this direction: perturbed affine image of a triangular lattice

Propose ONE conjecture in response, within that direction.
Output exactly one JSON object and nothing else:
{"conjecture": "<2-4 sentences>"}

message.content: {"conjecture": "Within the class of perturbed affine images of a triangular lattice, the optimal 13-point configuration consists of an 11-point hexagonal patch (a central point plus two surrounding rings) inscribed in the unit square, augmented by two boundary-adjacent points on the longest edge that break a remaining area-degeneracy. The largest achievable minimum triangle area for this construction is 1/140, attained by optimizing the affine aspect ratio and applying an area-preserving perturbation of magnitude roughly 0.01 to selected lattice sites."}
